question: How many minutes will Radha take to cover a distance of 1950 m. if she runs at a speed of 26 km\h?
solution:
**Given: **

Distance = 1950 m

Speed = 26 km/hr

**Formula Used:**

Time = Distance/Speed

1 km = 1000 m

1 hr = 60 min

**Calculation: **

26 km/hr =** 26 × (1000)/(60) **= (1300)/(3)m/min.

⇒ Time = 1950 ÷ (1300)/(3)

⇒ Time = 1950 × (3)/(1300)

⇒ Time = 4(1)/(2) minutes

**∴ In 4(1)/(2)minutes will be taken to cover 1950 m.**

8
